android_mechanism: Repeated category-ID lookup executed for every imported row; fix caches IDs in memory
bug_description: Every time a page finishes loading, onSaveHistory -> RdbUtils.insertDate re-queries the date_table for the current date and re-runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for the per-day history table, even though the same date is looked up on every save within a session. The redundant query + DDL run on each page navigation and add avoidable RDB round-trips to the page-save path.
fix_summary: Cache already-verified per-day tables in an in-memory Set (RdbUtils.knownDates); insertDate returns early on cache hit, and deleteAll clears the cache.
trigger_steps: Install and launch the app; start hitrace capture (categories: ace, app, disk).
Browse 20 pages sequentially through the address bar (each page load triggers onSaveHistory).
Stop hitrace; repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed; then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions identically.

test_oracle.definition: Count of RDB statement executions attributable to history saving (date_table SELECT + CREATE TABLE + history INSERT) per page load, from disk/sqlite activity in the hitrace trace or RDB debug logs.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed: >= 3 statements per page save after the first (SELECT + CREATE TABLE + INSERT); fixed: 1 statement per page save (INSERT only). Overall page-save wall time in trace drops accordingly.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 30 ace app sched disk -o /data/local/tmp/browser_insertdate.chtrace
